nodes.name: Warrior Mastery
nodes.effect: Choose exactly one ability from Ruinhewer, SteelBearer, or BrandBlade. The chosen ability is available while no Warrior subclass is active and while using a different Warrior subclass. It keeps its normal Energy cost, cooldown, targeting, damage type, scaling, statuses, and other printed mechanics. If the active Warrior subclass is the same subclass that supplied the chosen ability, the Warrior Mastery copy is removed and that subclass's normal copy follows its ordinary Character Level unlock; when that source subclass is no longer active, the Warrior Mastery copy returns. Duplicate copies are never allowed. If the chosen ability itself creates, tracks, or spends a named subclass resource, that resource may exist only as needed to resolve the chosen ability's own printed mechanics; Warrior Mastery does not grant the source subclass passive or unrelated resource-generation rules. The chosen Mastery ability is locked for the duration of an active campaign and may be changed at the Tavern while outside an active campaign.

nodes.effect: If a target affected by Dissonant Chord misses an attack or that attack is Dodged, refresh Dissonant Chord's remaining duration to 2 turns and your next Bard damaging ability against it gains +15% final damage.

nodes.name: Two-Sided Song
nodes.effect: If you gain Resonance from both the ally-facing trigger and enemy-facing trigger in the same turn, your next Bard ability gains +5% final effect.

nodes.name: Overflowing Verse
nodes.effect: At 4 Resonance, the first Resonance you would gain from healing or shielding each turn instead gives your next Bard damaging ability +5% final damage.

nodes.name: Overflowing Chord
nodes.effect: At 4 Resonance, the first Resonance you would gain from damaging or debuffing each turn instead gives your next Bard heal or Shield +5% final effect.

nodes.name: Full Crescendo
nodes.effect: Crescendo retains Full Resonance for its entire resolution even though it spends all Resonance.

nodes.name: Resonant Reserve
nodes.effect: After Crescendo spends 4 Resonance, set Resonance to 1.

nodes.name: Perfect Timing
nodes.effect: At 4 Resonance, the first Bard ability each turn that affects both enemies and allies costs 1 less Energy.

nodes.name: Never Waste a Note
nodes.effect: At 4 Resonance, the first Resonance you would otherwise waste each turn instead reduces the remaining cooldown of Encouraging Verse, Dissonant Chord, or Echoing Chorus by 1 turn.

nodes.name: Call and Response
nodes.effect: The first enemy-affecting Bard ability each turn empowers your next ally-affecting Bard heal or Shield by +12%. The first ally-affecting Bard heal or Shield each turn empowers your next enemy-affecting Bard damaging ability by +12%. If both empowerments are consumed in the same turn, gain 1 Resonance after the second resolves.

nodes.name: Unsafe Precision
nodes.effect: At 4 Redline, Sorcerer damaging abilities ignore 50% of the target's Block Chance.

nodes.name: Wild Detonation
nodes.effect: Cross the Redline against a target affected by Force Pulse's Block reduction gains +15% final damage and is Unblockable.

nodes.name: Guard the Spark
nodes.effect: While Wild Guard remains, gain +5 percentage points Blocked Damage Reduction.

nodes.name: Guarded Pulse
nodes.effect: Casting Force Pulse while Wild Guard remains increases Wild Guard's remaining Shield by 10% of its original amount, once per Wild Guard.

nodes.name: Shielded Redline
nodes.effect: The first time each Wild Guard absorbs damage, gain 1 Redline.

nodes.name: Unstable Shield
nodes.effect: Casting Wild Guard at 4 Redline makes its Shield 20% stronger.

nodes.name: Guard Breakout
nodes.effect: When Wild Guard is completely broken, your next Sorcerer damaging ability before the end of your next turn deals +15% final damage.

nodes.name: Containment Release
nodes.effect: When Wild Guard is completely broken, your next Energy-costing Sorcerer ability before the end of your next turn costs 1 less Energy.

nodes.name: Violent Containment
nodes.effect: If Wild Guard is broken while you are at 4 Redline, your next Sorcerer damaging ability gains +20% final damage and +15% Critical Damage.

nodes.name: Edge Power
nodes.effect: At 3 or more Redline, Sorcerer damaging abilities gain +5% Critical Damage.

nodes.name: Reach the Edge
nodes.effect: When you first reach 4 Redline, gain +5% final damage until the end of your next turn.

nodes.name: Excess Heat
nodes.effect: At 4 Redline, the first Redline you would gain from spending Energy each turn instead gives your next Sorcerer ability +5% final effect.

nodes.name: Excess Spark
nodes.effect: At 4 Redline, the first Redline you would gain from a damaging Crit each turn instead gives your next Sorcerer damaging ability +10% Critical Damage.

nodes.name: Redline Reserve
nodes.effect: After Cross the Redline spends all 4 Redline, set Redline to 1.

nodes.name: Pay for Power
nodes.effect: The first time each turn you pay Beyond Safe Limits' extra +1 Energy, that ability gains +15% final effect.

nodes.name: Ride the Line
nodes.effect: Beyond Safe Limits' +1 Energy cost applies only to the first Energy-costing Sorcerer ability you use each turn while at 4 Redline.

nodes.name: Beyond the Redline
nodes.effect: While at 4 Redline, every ability that actually pays Beyond Safe Limits' extra +1 Energy gains +10% final effect; damaging abilities also gain +15% Critical Damage. After Cross the Redline spends all 4 Redline, set Redline to 2.

nodes.name: Collect the Cursed

nodes.name: Expired Terms
nodes.effect: When your Binding Clause expires naturally, gain 1 Covenant Mark, once per target per cast.

nodes.name: Fine Print
nodes.effect: Casting Binding Clause on a target already affected by your Binding Clause also reduces its Block Chance and Dodge Chance by 10 percentage points for 2 turns.

nodes.name: Leech the Cursed
nodes.effect: Leeching Word's self-healing is 20% stronger against a debuffed target.

nodes.name: Deep Drain
nodes.effect: Leeching Word heals for an additional 5 percentage points of actual HP removed.

nodes.name: Shared Recovery
nodes.effect: If Shared Debt's Shield and heal are applied to the same ally, both effects are 10% stronger.

nodes.name: Debt Overflow
nodes.effect: When Leeching Word would heal you beyond Maximum HP, 30% of the excess healing becomes a Shield.

nodes.name: Desperate Collection
nodes.effect: Collect the Debt's ally-heal is 20% stronger if the selected ally is below 30% HP.

nodes.name: Debt Returned
nodes.effect: If an ally protected or healed by Shared Debt takes HP damage before your next turn, your next Leeching Word before the end of your next turn deals +20% final damage.

nodes.name: Blood in the Contract
nodes.effect: At 4 Covenant Marks, the first Leeching Word each turn that restores actual HP also creates a Shield on you equal to 50% of the actual HP restored.

nodes.name: Two-Part Contract
nodes.effect: If you gain a Covenant Mark from both a negative-status trigger and an actual-healing trigger in the same turn, gain +5% Dark damage and +5% Outgoing Healing until your next turn.

nodes.name: Overflowing Curse
nodes.effect: At 4 Covenant Marks, the first Mark you would gain from applying or refreshing a negative status each turn instead gives your next Warlock heal +5% final healing.

nodes.name: Overflowing Life
nodes.effect: At 4 Covenant Marks, the first Mark you would gain from actual healing each turn instead gives your next Warlock damaging ability +5% final damage.

nodes.name: Fulfilled Collection

nodes.name: Covenant Reserve
nodes.effect: After Collect the Debt spends 4 Covenant Marks, set Covenant Marks to 1.

nodes.name: Rewritten Terms
nodes.effect: At 4 Covenant Marks, the first Mark you would otherwise waste each turn instead reduces the remaining cooldown of Leeching Word or Binding Clause by 1 turn.

nodes.name: Cheap Fulfillment
nodes.effect: At 4 Covenant Marks, the first Warlock ability each turn that would normally generate a Covenant Mark costs 1 less Energy, minimum 0.

nodes.name: The Contract Continues
nodes.effect: Covenant Fulfilled remains active until the end of the current turn after Covenant Marks are spent. Collect the Debt returns 2 Covenant Marks after resolving. Once per turn, gaining Marks from both Covenant triggers reduces Collect the Debt's remaining cooldown by 1 turn.
